reset_root.rule: async assert / sync release per partition (2 stages), data and stations reset-less, release counted; hub_C PLL lock -> host -> die_rst_n

tool_requests: schema: clocks[] (name, source part/leaf pin, spine, insertion, neighbour skew) and per-type clock_taps{clock: tap_um}; per-bus clock (default core)
gen_rtl: one clk port per clock of the type; boundary flops of a bus on its clock
g2: route every clock spine root -> its taps; report reach per clock
reset.source may be a partition bus (hub_Wi die_rst_n); die_top: por pin -> that partition
